title: 茶水间英文 - 11月20日 | 种族灭绝裁决、AI巨头暴涨、霉霉回归CMA
description:
The World Court made history on Thursday, ruling for the first time ever that a country committed genocide, in a case about Myanmar's treatment of the Rohingya. Anthropic's record-breaking IPO had a wild first day of trading, jumping to a two trillion dollar valuation before cooling off, while Taylor Swift returned to the Country Music Awards stage after thirteen years with a surprise throwback to Our Song.

周四，联合国最高法院作出历史性裁决，首次认定一个国家犯下种族灭绝罪，缅甸被判对罗兴亚人实施种族灭绝。Anthropic 创纪录的 IPO 首日交易大起大落，开盘冲上两万亿美元估值后回落；泰勒·斯威夫特时隔十三年重返乡村音乐奖舞台，惊喜演唱出道曲《Our Song》。今天还有一个随机问题：如果一觉醒来只有硬币那么大，你会先干什么？

Words to steal 生词本：
- genocide — 种族灭绝
- turning point — 转折点
- reparations — 赔偿；赔款
- roller coaster — 过山车；大起大落
- split screen — 冰火两重天；对比画面
- homecoming — 回归；重返故地
- walk down memory lane — 回忆往昔；重温旧梦
- dust off — 重新拿出来；拂去灰尘再用
